notes:
Account background: Foxwell is a payments processor powering transaction routing and dispute workflows for mid-size banks and fintech apps. They came on as a Hosted API customer in 2021, moved to a small Dedicated pool in 2023 for latency guarantees. Renewal discussion kicked off Q1 2026.

Sales context / ask: looking to expand Dedicated capacity (x3 GPUs) to support a new real-time fraud scoring service and increase embedding throughput for customer 360. Very interested in Redwood Optimize to reduce per-token cost for batch reconciliation jobs. Mentioned goal: reduce inference cost by ~40% through batching + quantization without hurting recall on fraud model.

Security / compliance: strict EU data residency for PSD2 clients; want Redwood Private control plane for EU footprint or strict VPC routing. Legal has specific redlines around cross-border logs and 90-day audit log retention. IT asked for HSM-backed key management and SOC2 type II + ISO27001 evidence.

Customer quotes (paraphrased): "We need deterministic latency under 120ms p95 for our fraud scorer in production windows"; "If we can hit promised cost reductions on Optimize pilot, we will reallocate more budget from model infra to product features".

Internal notes: AE/Jordan owns commercial; SE/Priya leading architecture + sizing; CSM/Liam prepping onboarding plan for expanded pool. Procurement now looped (legal contact: Marta Silva, procurement contact: Rajiv Menon). Team receptive to multi-region (NA primary, EU secondary) architecture and automatic fallback to smaller model variants during bursts.

Risks: procurement org restructure slowing signature; strict legal redlines on data residency could push to Private which increases onboarding time by ~8-12 weeks. Need final confirmation on expected QPS profile before we commit to GPU type (A10G vs H100).

Suggested pitch: bundle Dedicated expansion with 6-month Optimize pilot (SLA for cost improvements), include a two-week EU Private pilot clause in contract as contingency.
